_why: MINIMAL VALID create body for Survey. Hand-authored, not generated.
A body of pure sentinels 400s before it ever reaches the mapper, and a baseline in which
every CREATE 400s satisfies every other gate while covering the write path not at all.
Draft is nullable on create - the server stamps an empty-but-valid skeleton.
TRAP3-WRITE PROBE: publishedVersionNumber is documented read-only and is dropped on the
DTO->entity map (GeneralMappingProfile.cs:41-42) because the publish flow derives it.
4242 is a value no publish flow could ever produce. If the readback shows 4242, the
generated mapper started writing it by convention and the trap has fired.
name: PARITY-CREATE-SURVEY
